if: a registered person is liable to pay tax under s.9(3) or s.9(4)
he makes payment to the supplier
then: he SHALL ISSUE A PAYMENT VOUCHER at the time of making that payment
note: A separate document from the self-invoice in s.31(3)(f), with a different trigger: the self-invoice is triggered by receipt from an unregistered supplier, the payment voucher by making payment, and this clause is not limited to unregistered suppliers. The source is the CGST Act as updated 31-08-2021. UNKNOWN whether a later amendment has changed this provision; later amendments are not held locally.

evidence.quote: section (4) of section 9 shall issue a payment voucher at the time of making payment to the supplier.
